subtitle: Unchecked categories are skipped. If you haven't touched anything, the defaults are safe.

blacklist.hint: Libraries, optimization mods and author tooling are excluded by default — only the pack author ever reads their text. Matching is by mod id, and excluding a mod never removes translations it already ships.

hardcoded.header: Text no language file can reach
hardcoded.summary: {{mods}} mods hardcode {{strings}} display strings in their code
hardcoded.hint: These mods build the text in Java instead of reading it from a language file, so the game never looks up a translation for it. No tool that edits language files can change it — not moru, not a hand translation, not a resource pack. It stays English, and that is not a translation failure. Fixing it needs a Mixin shipped as a companion mod; a resource pack cannot carry code.

overrides.summary: Enabled resource packs replaced {{keys}} source strings — the text players actually see is what gets translated
